panels.title: Briefing Gen 成功率（7d）
panels.description: commodity_briefings gen_status=succeeded / total，近 7 日滚动

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE gen_status = 'succeeded')::float / COUNT(*)
  END AS value
FROM commodity_briefings
WHERE created_at >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Briefing Push 成功率（24h）
panels.description: briefing_pushes push_status=succeeded / total，近 24 小时滚动

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('hour', pushed_at) AS time,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE push_status = 'succeeded')::float / COUNT(*)
  END AS value
FROM briefing_pushes
WHERE pushed_at >= now() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Briefing 字段覆盖率（当日均值）
panels.description: commodity_briefings payload_json 第一层 9 字段完整度均值；null / '—' 计为缺失

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  now() AS time,
  AVG(
    (
      CASE WHEN payload_json->>'cu'        IS NOT NULL AND payload_json->>'cu'        != '—' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
      CASE WHEN payload_json->>'lc'        IS NOT NULL AND payload_json->>'lc'        != '—' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
      CASE WHEN payload_json->>'al'        IS NOT NULL AND payload_json->>'al'        != '—' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
      CASE WHEN payload_json->>'zn'        IS NOT NULL AND payload_json->>'zn'        != '—' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
      CASE WHEN payload_json->>'ni'        IS NOT NULL AND payload_json->>'ni'        != '—' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
      CASE WHEN payload_json->>'fe'        IS NOT NULL AND payload_json->>'fe'        != '—' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
      CASE WHEN payload_json->>'coal'      IS NOT NULL AND payload_json->>'coal'      != '—' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
      CASE WHEN payload_json->>'lithium'   IS NOT NULL AND payload_json->>'lithium'   != '—' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
      CASE WHEN payload_json->>'overview'  IS NOT NULL AND payload_json->>'overview'  != '—' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    )::float / 9
  ) AS value
FROM commodity_briefings
WHERE briefing_date = CURRENT_DATE

panels.title: Quotes Fetch 时延（P50 / P95）
panels.description: commodity_quotes fetched_at - observed_at 的中位数与 p95，按小时聚合

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('hour', fetched_at) AS time,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (fetched_at - observed_at))) AS p50,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (fetched_at - observed_at))) AS p95
FROM commodity_quotes
WHERE fetched_at >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND observed_at IS NOT NULL
  AND fetched_at > observed_at
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Kimi 月度成本估算（CNY）
panels.description: briefing-gen Kimi token 用量 × 单价（input: ¥0.015/1K token, output: ¥0.06/1K token）；仅当月累计

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time,
  SUM(
    (COALESCE((meta->>'kimi_input_tokens')::bigint, 0) * 0.015 / 1000.0) +
    (COALESCE((meta->>'kimi_output_tokens')::bigint, 0) * 0.06 / 1000.0)
  ) AS daily_cost
FROM commodity_briefings
WHERE created_at >= date_trunc('month', now())
  AND gen_status = 'succeeded'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  now() AS time,
  SUM(
    (COALESCE((meta->>'kimi_input_tokens')::bigint, 0) * 0.015 / 1000.0) +
    (COALESCE((meta->>'kimi_output_tokens')::bigint, 0) * 0.06 / 1000.0)
  ) AS monthly_total
FROM commodity_briefings
WHERE created_at >= date_trunc('month', now())
  AND gen_status = 'succeeded'
